experimental_method: Batch flow-microcalorimetry: 0.4161 cm3 of O2 injected from a gas syringe into flowing water (1e-8 m3/s) in a flow microcalorimeter at 298.15 K, with electrical calibration.
uncertainties_stated: Mean -DeltaH = 12.056 +- 0.019 kJ/mol (2 sigma of mean); with possible systematic errors -(12.06 +- 0.04) kJ/mol; systematic terms (calibration constant, water-vapour condensation correction) each believed < 0.2 percent.
quality_remarks: Authors report agreement with Benson et al. (12.02 kJ/mol from solubilities). Mean pressure drop caused by the gas bubble 20 Pa. Temperature scale not stated.
changes_after_image_check: table_1 row 2 (-DeltaH column row 3 of data): 920.11 printed in text as '920.1 I' -> 920.11 (I column)
extraction_notes: Text layer is a noisy scan OCR with glyph errors in a few cells; all values were set from the page image. Calibration constants placed on the row above them (ambiguous). Only table in paper. Sanity: all -DeltaH between 11.965 and 12.147 kJ/mol; mean of 17 rows checked to be consistent with 12.056.
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer is OCR with glyph errors in several cells (corrections made after image check).
